title: Warreth
tagline: A decentralized platform for issuing warranties for purchased products/items.
description:
--> Sellers can use Warreth, a decentralised platform for issuing warranties, to send their warranties to customers through a NFT made with Polygon.  

--> Free up some cabinet space and store your warranties on NFTs with the right ownership proof in the digital world. Now, the warranty is a kind of token rather than a piece of paper. By registering below, you can begin storing warranties. 

-->With the addition of expiration date and resell features that make it convenient to be used in numerous additional use-cases, we have used the Soulbound NFT concept to provide warranties that cannot be the victim of theft.
how_its_made:
--> We were a particularly new team who had come to build something insightful and useful. and thats how we came upon warr.eth and warranties. 

--> First off all soulbouding Nfts is one of the most difficult part for us as we needed a third party app to help us hash our soul. eventually we came up across keccak256 hash which had good enough documentation, also working on new ideas that also need some implementations for the sponsor bounties, was particularly alien to us as we sat through documentations and tutorials explaining how our sponsors actually work and how we can implement them. 

-->A rather unique problem that we faced would be how to implement the automation of burning the nfts,the solution we found to it was the good old gelato ops.
